svg.text: Client-ready stage map of HyperTransfer compliance orchestration, Hex Safe custody integration, WTA settlement, OTC conversion, and controls

text.tspan: HyperTransfer owns the gates and audit state. External services stay behind backend adapters so Hex Trust/Sumsub, Notabene, Sygna, TRP, Chainalysis, TRM, Elliptic, and HT
Markets can be swapped or combined.
Hex Trust provides custody security; Operator/HyperTransfer enforces operator access controls, Macau access exclusion, receipt gating, and internal ledger controls.
Every critical action is logged: MFA, KYC, DepositRequest, source-wallet KYT, Travel Rule status, Hex Safe address issuance, confirmation finality, txHash KYT, WTA
settlement, OTC quote, dirty funds case, payout decision.
